The mammalian female reproductive tract begins with the ovary (site of egg production), followed by the oviduct (Fallopian tube) where fertilization typically occurs, then the uterus where embryonic development takes place, and finally the vagina which connects to the external environment.  
"Rete" and "epididymis" are not part of the female reproductive tract in this anatomical sequence.
